subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 24 00 panel schedule circuit assignment between Electrical

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 24 00 panel schedule circuit assignment between Sheet E-501 and Electrical Panel Schedule E-601 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up rough-in in this area. Please respond before the panel energization walkthrough.

Sheet E-501 governs for the Section 26 24 00 panel schedule circuit assignment near J-Box 4; Electrical Panel Schedule E-601 will be superseded by an updated drawing. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up rough-in in this area.
